name: XML Sitemap Generator
description: Generate a valid sitemap.xml from a list of URLs, with optional priority, change frequency, and last-modified date per entry — download it ready to upload.

faq.question: Do I need priority and changefreq for every URL?
faq.answer: No — a sitemap of bare URLs is completely valid. Both fields are optional hints that search engines weight lightly at best; they won't override how a page actually behaves or how often it's actually recrawled.

faq.question: Why did some of my URLs get flagged as errors instead of just being generated?
faq.answer: Each line is validated rather than trusted as-is: URLs must be absolute (https://example.com/page, not /page), priority must be between 0.0 and 1.0, and changefreq must be one of the values the sitemap protocol defines. Catching typos here is better than shipping a sitemap.xml that search engines silently reject entries from.

faq.question: Where does this file need to go once downloaded?
faq.answer: Typically at your domain root (https://example.com/sitemap.xml), then referenced from robots.txt with a Sitemap: line and optionally submitted directly to Google Search Console / Bing Webmaster Tools.
